author: Yasmine Mohieldin
content: Perfect! Very professional communication, managed to get softplay hired despite the very short notice. Zara has been very helpful and even tried to move clients around to ensure that we'll receive the equipment on time and have it picked up on time esp that our event was at a venue with sepcific booking time! The equipment we received was clean and in very good condition. It helped keeping the little ones entertained throughout the birthday party. Thanks Dancing Cubs team for a wonderful experience!
